levels.name: Twin lanes
levels.hint: Both robots run your program, one after the other. One program for two!

levels.name: Turned stairs
levels.hint: The stairs point different ways, but each robot turns its own way.

levels.name: Pond laps
levels.hint: Both robots go round a pond the same way. Can a Repeat hold a Repeat?

levels.name: Biggest number
levels.hint: Each robot stops on its own flag. Which Repeat number works for both?

levels.name: No counting
levels.hint: Short or long, Repeat until flag stops each robot on its own flag.

levels.name: Hop to it
levels.hint: Some robots hop more times than others. You do not need to count!

levels.name: Bends and ends
levels.hint: Corners and dead ends in different places. Look before you step!

levels.name: Turn either way
levels.hint: One road turns left, the other turns right. One program must do both!

levels.name: Three in one
levels.hint: A twisty road, a dead end and a hairpin. Can one program do them all?

levels.name: Gem signals
levels.hint: The gems show each robot where to turn, even when the path goes on.

levels.name: Gems and walls
levels.hint: A wall means turn left. A gem means turn right. Same rules for both!

levels.name: Side doors
levels.hint: The doors are in different places. Let each robot look for its own!

levels.name: Doors both sides
levels.hint: Take each door, left or right. Use else so the robot turns only once!

levels.name: Mind the loops
levels.hint: Little loops skip the gems. Stay on the road, and turn only at walls!

levels.name: Two mazes
levels.hint: Two different mazes, one program. Your maze rule works in both!

levels.name: Pond and maze
levels.hint: One robot starts next to a pond. Which hand keeps it from going round?

levels.name: Dead end gems
levels.hint: The gems hide in dead ends. Which hand peeks into them on the way?

levels.name: No peeking team
levels.hint: No If path ahead again! Your short maze rule works for both robots.

levels.name: Three shapes
levels.hint: A hairpin, some stairs and a T. One maze rule gets all three home!

levels.name: Maze team
levels.hint: Three mazes, one program. Which hand gets every robot home?
